name: handoff_checks
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,sys,subprocess
p=Path.cwd()
def write(n,s):
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
orig=json.loads((p/'originals.json').read_text());res=json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text());by={o['id']:o for o in orig}
for o in orig:
 assert hashlib.sha256(o['raw_line'].encode()).hexdigest()==o['raw_sha256']
 assert hashlib.sha256(o['statement_token'].encode()).hexdigest()==o['token_sha256']
 assert hashlib.sha256(o['statement'].encode()).hexdigest()==o['statement_sha256']
 assert json.loads(o['statement_token'])==o['statement'] and o['newline']
write('original20.jsonl',''.join(by[i]['raw_line'] for i in res['ids']))
r=json.loads((p/'results.json').read_text());assert set(map(int,r))==set(res['ids']);assert len(r)==20
required=['literal','original','source','final','ordinary','prior','novelty','significance','family','formal','independent','procedure','acceptance']
assert all(all(g in o for g in required) for o in r.values())
write('terminal-exclusions.json',json.dumps({'excluded_from_manifest':{'SHA256-MANIFEST.json':'Manifest cannot hash itself noncircularly.','final_manifest.receipt.json':'Terminal runner receipt produced after child completes manifest.','final_manifest.output.txt':'Terminal full stdout produced after child completes manifest.'},'all_other_own_lane_files':'Included with actual bytes and SHA256, including every already-completed receipt and frozen-after. No wildcard exclusion.','terminal_job':'final_manifest, synchronous/reaped at return. Its receipt remains delivered although not in self-dependent manifest.'},indent=2))
write('handoff-validation.json',json.dumps({'fixed20_IDs_exact':True,'all20_raw_token_decoded_hash_bindings':True,'all13_separate_gates_per_ID':True,'new_full_qualified_survivors':0,'acceptance_credit':0,'no_formal_dispatch':True,'history_read':768,'history_protected_filtered':78,'alljobs':'All completed synchronous jobs reaped; terminal manifest job likewise on return','one_local_failure':'domino_figures missing fitz; preserved, changed Poppler fallback successful','telemetry_limit':'Sampled RSS; native/writer peaks unavailable'},indent=2))
print('All20 original bindings and separate gates checked. Terminal exclusions named. No qualified survivor.')
